question: If 51% of first number is equal to six-sevenths of second number, what is the ratio of first number to the second number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, 51% of First Number = 6/7 of Second Number

⇒ First / Second = (6/7) × (100/51)

⇒ First / Second = 600 / 357

⇒ First / Second = 200 / 119

**∴ The correct answer is 200: 119.**
